title: בנימין רעיא
author: Heilprin source tradition; Warsaw digital witness

paragraphs: Binyamin the shepherd ate bread, blessing, “Blessed is the Merciful, master of this bread.” Rava (should be Rav) said he fulfilled the duty. Objection: did Rav not say, “Every blessing in which there is no mention of the Name,” etc.? Berakhot 40b.
